mapper.sql: f.id AS filing_id, f.accession_number, f.form_type, f.filing_date, f.accepted_at, f.primary_document, f.sec_url, f.status, f.error_message, f.created_at AS filing_created_at, f.updated_at AS filing_updated_at, c.id AS company_id, c.ticker AS company_ticker, c.cik AS company_cik, c.company_name, c.enabled AS company_enabled, c.created_at AS company_created_at, c.updated_at AS company_updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM FILING WHERE accession_number = #{accessionNumber}
SELECT FROM FILING f JOIN COMPANY c ON c.id = f.company_id WHERE f.accession_number = #{accessionNumber} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM FILING f JOIN COMPANY c ON c.id = f.company_id WHERE f.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM FILING f JOIN COMPANY c ON c.id = f.company_id WHERE f.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM FILING f JOIN COMPANY c ON c.id = f.company_id WHERE f.status IN #{status} ORDER BY f.id
SELECT FROM FILING f JOIN COMPANY c ON c.id = f.company_id ORDER BY f.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FILING (company_id, accession_number, form_type, filing_date, accepted_at, primary_document, sec_url, status, error_message, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{company.id}, #{accessionNumber}, #{formType}, #{filingDate}, #{acceptedAt}, #{primaryDocument}, #{secUrl}, #{status}, #{errorMessage}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE FILING SET status = #{status}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
